markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the Associated Press definitively calls the 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate election.
markets.rules_primary: If the Associated Press makes its first definitive call of a winner for the 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate election before 12:00 AM ET on Nov 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The call must be an explicit declaration that a candidate, party, or option has won, will win, or equivalent clear language indicating AP has determined the winner. The phrase "projected to win" alone is insufficient; it must be AP's clear election call. The call must appear on one of AP's primary platforms (main website, television broadcast, or official social media if that is its primary medium) and not be prefaced with qualifiers suggesting uncertainty such as "appears to," "likely to," "probably," or "may have." The relevant time is when the call first becomes publicly visible, not when it may have been written, decided internally, or prepared for publication. If the call is later retracted, the market resolves to Yes based on the call time. Preliminary exit polls, reporting of other outlets' calls, conditional statements, opinion pieces, and technical glitches do not qualify.
markets.title: Will AP call the 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate election before 12:00 AM ET on Nov 11, 2026?

markets.rules_secondary:
“Blocks” means that USPS refuses to accept, returns, holds, or materially delays ballot mail because of voter-list, barcode, certification, portal-submission, or similar election-specific requirements imposed pursuant to the covered measure. The threshold may be aggregated across incidents, but each ballot counts only once; warnings, promptly corrected interruptions, and ordinary postal problems unrelated to the covered measure do not qualify.

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Truth Social posts by Donald Trump on Nov 10, 2026 is below 5, then the market resolves to Yes.

How this is resolved

The observation period begins at 12:00:00 AM ET on Nov 10, 2026 and ends at 11:59:59 PM ET on Nov 10, 2026.

In the event that Roll Call data is unavailable or inaccurate, alternative sources may be used at Kalshi's discretion.

Truths, ReTruths, and Quote Truths are included in the total count.
Replies are included if captured by Roll Call.
"Between" is inclusive of the lower and upper bound.

Doesn’t count for payout: Posts deleted as of 12:00 AM ET.

markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, only the Knesset's election of a Speaker in a vote qualifies. The first election for Speaker of the Knesset after the Oct 27, 2026 Knesset election is the first vote in which the Knesset elected on Oct 27, 2026 elects a Speaker, including an interim or temporary Speaker or the re-election of the outgoing Speaker; a later replacement does not change the outcome.

The outgoing Speaker continuing without such a vote, a Deputy Speaker, and a member presiding or acting as Speaker do not count. Neither does a request or letter asking for a Speaker vote, or the announcement or scheduling of a vote.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of the Treasury announces sanctions on a Chinese bank before Nov 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Chinese bank means an institution holding a banking licence from China's National Financial Regulatory Administration or from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. A designation naming only a subsidiary, branch, affiliate or parent counts only if the licensed bank itself is named, and one qualifying bank is sufficient.

Adding a qualifying bank to the SDN List or the CAPTA List, or a FinCEN final rule imposing a Section 311 special measure on one, resolves the market to YES. The stated reason for the designation is irrelevant, and a later delisting does not reverse a resolution already made.

A threat or reported plan, a civil penalty over past conduct, addition to the Commerce Entity List, sanctions by another government, or designation of a Chinese entity that is not a licensed bank, such as a payment processor, exchange house, refinery or trading firm, do NOT resolve the market to Yes.

Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

If two or more cryptocurrencies report an identical return (rounded to three decimal places) such that they are tied for the highest
position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."
